summary.text: Ryan Hampton is the Democratic candidate for the Nevada State Assembly, District 9, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

A nonprofit founder in long-term recovery from addiction, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he represented more than 120,000 victims in the Purdue Pharma bankruptcy case and is running on lowering costs and protecting healthcare access.

paragraphs.text: Ryan Hampton graduated from MAST Academy, and Ballotpedia lists his profession as nonprofit founder.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is a community advocate, small business owner and nonprofit founder who has been in recovery for 11 years, and that Medicaid saved his life.
He said he founded the nonprofit Mobilize Recovery and was named to the 2026 TIME100 Health list.
Hampton advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.

He said his priorities are healthcare, including behavioral health, addiction recovery and protecting Medicaid, and economic affordability, including lower housing and essential costs and good-paying jobs.
He listed endorsements from U.S. Representatives Dina Titus, Susie Lee and Ro Khanna and Assembly Speaker Steve Yeager.
